items.text: Explain what an API is using a real-world analogy
Describe the role of API Gateway as a front door / middleman
List the four parts of every HTTP request (Method, URL, Headers, Body)
Identify what each HTTP method does: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH
Explain the difference between 2xx, 4xx, and 5xx status codes
Distinguish between 401 (Unauthorized) and 403 (Forbidden)
Explain how path + method together define a unique API operation
Describe what a VPC Endpoint is and the problem it solves
Create an API Gateway with a resource path and HTTP method
Integrate API Gateway with a Lambda function (proxy integration)
Deploy an API to a stage and retrieve the Invoke URL
Differentiate between REST API, HTTP API, and WebSocket API types
Create a Gateway VPC Endpoint and attach it to a route table
Explain when to use Gateway vs Interface Endpoints
Know the default API Gateway throttle limits: 10,000 RPS, 5,000 burst
Know that Gateway Endpoints are free and support only S3 and DynamoDB
Know that Interface Endpoints create an ENI and support most AWS services
Identify correct status codes for common scenarios (404, 401, 403, 500)
Know that HTTP API is cheaper and lower latency than REST API
Know that WebSocket API is for real-time bidirectional communication
